profile_text.body:
Dynatrace, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, trading under the ticker DT. According to its website, it sells an observability platform that combines observability, AI, automation, and application security, and it describes itself as an AI-powered observability leader. The site says the platform is built for the age of AI and aims to help customers innovate faster, operate more efficiently, and improve business outcomes.

The site presents the company's direction as preventive and autonomous observability, using what it calls deterministic AI and AI agents to coordinate actions across cloud platforms, developer tools, and IT service management. It quotes Stephen Elliot, Group Vice President at IDC, on that theme, and includes a customer statement that the AI engine supports early detection of potential system issues without false alarms and cuts root cause identification from hours to minutes.

The record also notes law exposure in Massachusetts, with a count of 191. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are listed for the company.
